definitions.claims_moved_after_record: Largest per-node difference between claims after the last _post_round and holdings[-1].
definitions.gini_close, top1_wealth, top10_wealth: Claims in holdings[-1], the history row of the last round, written before that round's _post_round. The fiscal arms pay the transfer and the asset carrier settles in _post_round, so on those arms these precede the last cash move; on the others nothing moves after them. 'wealth' here is claims (cash), not net worth.
definitions.gini_init, top1_init, top10_init: Claims the model holds before round one.
definitions.gini_net_worth_post: After the last _post_round: claims plus units held at the closing price on the asset carrier, claims alone elsewhere.
definitions.gini_open, top1_open, top10_open: Claims in holdings[0], the history row of the first round, written after that round's network step. Not the claims the model opens with; those are the *_init fields.
definitions.gini_post, top1_post, top10_post: Claims after the last _post_round, the run's final cash.
definitions.in_graph_close: Nodes in the graph after the last round.
definitions.out_rounds, out_node_rounds, out_peak, e: Over all rounds, of the set starved counts: rounds with anyone in it, node-rounds in it, its largest size, nodes ever in it.
definitions.returns: Times a node was in that set on one round and out of it on the next. Zero by construction on the absorbing exit arms.
definitions.starved, frozen in the history: Read against starved_object. out_of_graph (exit mode): nodes that have left the graph. below_floor_in_graph (drawdown mode): nodes below the floor this round, every one still in the graph and spending min(need, holdings). none: no floor on this arm.
